about: Scenarios for `npm run skill-evals`. A driver (a person or an agent) runs each one in /tmp/pk-e2e/<id>, one fresh Codex session per Step, answering questions from `answers`, and turns `checks` into verify calls after the Step named. `<head:X>` is the HEAD recorded before Step X (steps/X.head). Assertions the Skills guarantee regardless of the app are the ones that matter; wording is never graded.
every_step: commits: every new commit descends from <head:step>, subject <= 72 chars, no attribution, SENTINEL.txt in none
every_job_step: plan: the Job's <job-record> block parses with JobRecordSchema and planJobIds reads the Job
plan: every SHA the record holds (commits, each attempt's commit and reviewedCommits) is 40 lowercase hex and a commit
plan (B-E): attempts only grow and at most one commits key changed, against `before` = steps/<label>.plan-before, which `step --plan <plan>` writes

brief.title: Slugify
brief.description: Add slugify(text) to src/text.js: lower-case, ASCII letters and digits kept, runs of anything else become one hyphen, no leading or trailing hyphen. Export it and test it.

steps.label: 0-setup
steps.answers: Committed tracker. Accept every recommendation. No extra sections.
checks: file .mysdd/issue-tracker.md matches ^Tracker contract: <N>$ once
setup's own files committed or left for the user as the skill says

steps.label: 1-grill
steps.answers: Answer from the brief; keep it to one function; no Unicode transliteration; empty string returns empty string.

steps.label: 2-spec
checks: file <spec> exists
spec-marker <spec> = brief.id

steps.label: 3-spec-review
checks: file <spec> still has its US-NNN ids and kanban-brief marker

steps.label: 4-to-issues
checks: every issues/*.json parses with IssueFileSchema, status ready-for-agent
commits: one SPEC: commit holding exactly the spec and issue files

steps.label: 5-implement
checks: issue status done-coding-awaiting-final-review, codeCommit recorded and its subject is the CODE: commit
comments match Deviations and tradeoffs:
npm test passes

steps.label: 6-final-review
checks: issue status unchanged (done-coding-awaiting-final-review)
reviewHistoryCommit recorded, resolves, holds only the issue file
comments match ^Final review, phase 1, attempt 1 and Verdict:

steps.label: 7-review-fix
checks: issue status done-final-review only if the record says COMPLETE
reviewCodeCommit recorded and resolves
comments match ^Final review, phase 2, attempt 1 and Outcome:

scenarios.repo: fixture node-app, `.mysdd/features/` listed in .gitignore before setup
scenarios.steps: setup (local mode), then 2, 4, 5, 6, 7 as in mm-agile, with the Spec written straight from the brief at step 2
checks: tracker states local mode
no commit ever holds a path under .mysdd/features/
6 and 7 each commit an empty marker: tree equal to its parent, index untouched
the SHA each review records is that marker

job.title: Word count
job.description: Add wordCount(text) to src/text.js: whitespace-separated words, 0 for blank text. Export and test it.

steps.label: A-plan
steps.answers: Approve the plan. Write it to .claude/plans/word-count.md.
checks: plan exists, owned by the Job (planJobIds), has ## Request, ends with the empty <job-record> block

steps.label: B-plan-review
checks: plan records plan-review and it resolves
attempts gained one step B attempt whose commit is the plan-review SHA

steps.label: C-code
checks: plan records code, subject is the change commit
npm test passes
attempts gained one step C attempt, its commit the code SHA

steps.label: D-code-review
checks: plan records code-review
no source file changed
attempts gained one step D attempt whose reviewedCommits hold the code SHA

steps.label: E-code-fix
checks: plan records code-fix only when E made a CODE REVIEW FIXES commit
JOB HISTORY: Record step E attempt <N> holds only the plan
attempts gained one step E attempt; earlier attempts unchanged

scenarios.repo: fixture node-app, `.claude/plans/` ignored, plan written by hand ending with jobRecordTemplate(<job id>)
scenarios.steps: B, D (after a hand-made code commit), E
checks: each step records its commit (the ignored-plan marker)
no commit holds the plan
plan still owned by the Job

scenarios.repo: git clone --no-hardlinks <a Makerkit project> (remote removed; ask before pnpm install)
scenarios.steps: setup upgrades its contract-less tracker, then 1-7 as in mm-agile on a one-issue feature, then one A-E pass
checks: tracker states the current contract once, project sections kept
the mm-agile and mm-jobs checks

scenarios.repo: the mm-jobs repo after C, and the mm-agile repo after 5
scenarios.steps: `$kanban-jobs` step B named by hand (no app prompt); `$modified-matt-final-review` with only the Issue path, to infer phase 1
checks: kanban-jobs asks for the Job ID or plan it is missing rather than guessing
final-review infers phase 1 and records it as in mm-agile step 6
